title: Klonoa - Empire of Dreams
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 1100003653 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Puzzle Platformer. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. PC mGBA sweep (boot, mash, walk; C2 gbaverify): lives 3 -> 2 and hearts 3 -> 2 -> 1 -> refill to 3 after losing a life. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: B shoot the Wind Bullet to grab enemies, A jump; with an enemy held, jump again for a double jump or throw it.
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: Grabbed enemies are used to break blocks, hit switches and reach high ledges.
widgets.label: Use

widgets.text: Grab the bombs/enemies the boss sends and throw them back.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Several kingdoms, each with stages including hoverboard stages.
widgets.label: Worlds

widgets.text: Dream stones and hearts for health; keys (stars) open the exit.
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text: 3 stars (keys) open each stage's exit; 150 dream stones in a stage unlock bonus.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: Clear the worlds to defeat the nightmare that troubles Jillius.
widgets.label: Goal
